# Board Meeting Prep
Date: 2026-09-02 | Duration: 63.040000915527344m

## Summary
The team focused on securing Anthropic’s partnership and preparing for renewal with a $3 million ARR floor, separating license fees from platform or premium support fees, and addressing underutilization after approximately 600 of 4,000 contracted hours were used. Weekly engagement continues across Anthropic’s data science and feature flag engineering teams, while Austin requires deeper engagement and broader support. Sales discussions covered the $185K OpenDoor win, early opportunities such as Notion, outbound prospecting, and differentiation from Statsig, Datadog, Confidence, and other competitors. Growth Book’s AI strategy combines embedded product features with positioning as experimentation infrastructure for AI products. Pricing discussions favored optional event forwarding, experiment-based pricing for Pro customers, and real-time analytics as an upsell, with changes slowed beyond version 5.1. Marketing and board communications should emphasize strategic initiatives and proof points. Pro MRR declined from $130K to $129K because of a temporary billing bug, while managed warehouse adoption increased among new free organizations.

## Keywords
Anthropic, pricing strategy, warehouse native, real-time analytics, AI integration, marketing strategy
